widgets_values: A dreamy cinematic portrait photograph of one young Asian woman in a sunlit summer garden at golden hour. She has a delicate oval face with fair luminous skin, soft natural makeup, gentle pink lips, and large dark eyes looking calmly and dreamily slightly off-camera. Her long, voluminous black hair flows softly around her shoulders, the edges catching a warm orange rim light from the low sun behind her. She wears a simple white sleeveless garment with bare shoulders visible, her body turned slightly away while her face angles toward the camera in a serene, contemplative gaze. She is surrounded by a lush field of orange, white and pink cosmos flowers, with several blooms softly out of focus in the foreground framing her face and shoulders. Framed from the upper chest upward in a tall 2:3 vertical composition, the shallow depth of field renders the garden into creamy bokeh while her face and the rim-lit edges of her hair stay tack sharp. Warm golden-hour backlight blends with soft natural daylight on her skin, producing a fresh, luminous, dreamlike summer portrait with rich soft texture.
